scenarios.title: After the earthquake
scenarios.summary: A first conversation with an earthquake survivor staying in temporary accommodation. His family is safe, but he has lost his home and fears further aftershocks.

scenarios.title: After a loss
scenarios.summary: An adult coping with the death of his father. Feelings of loss, anger and guilt emerge gradually through conversation.

scenarios.title: After witnessing a fire
scenarios.summary: An uninjured witness who remains unsettled after a neighbourhood fire and avoids reminders of what he saw.

scenarios.title: Running out of energy
scenarios.summary: An adult struggling with persistent exhaustion, work mistakes and self-doubt, unsure why ordinary rest is not helping.
scenarios.focus: Exploring daily functioning without premature conclusions
